==Russian==

===Etymology 1===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*peyḱ-|id=mark}} {{dercat|ru|ine-bsl-pro|ine-pro|inh=1}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|писати||to write; to paint}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*pьsati}}. Related to {{m+|la|pingō}} (whence {{m+|en|paint}} and {{m|en|picture}}).

====Pronunciation====
* {{ru-IPA|писа́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-писать.ogg}}

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|писа́ть|impf|pf=написа́ть|vn=писа́ние<q:nomen actionis; nomen obiecti>,письмо́<q:nomen actionis; nomen obiecti>,писа́льщик<q:nomen agentis, occasional>,пи́сарь<q:nomen agentis>,писа́тель<q:nomen agentis>,писа́ка<q:nomen agentis>,писани́на<q:nomen resultatis>|vadj=пи́саный,пису́чий}}

# to [[write]]
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1846|author=w:ru:Фёдор Достоевский<t:{{w|Fyodor Dostoevsky}}>|title=w:ru:[[Бедные люди]]|chapter=s:ru:[[Бедные люди (Достоевский)/Апрель1|Апреля 8.]]|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=w:Constance Garnett|title2=s:en:[[The Gambler and Other Stories/Poor People|Poor People]]|location2=|publisher2=|year2=1914|page2=|pageurl2=|text=Вы говори́те, что у вас глаза́ слабе́ют, так не '''пиши́те''' при свеча́х; заче́м '''писа́ть'''?|t=You say your eyes are weak; so you must not '''write''' by candlelight; why '''write'''?}}
# {{lb|ru|literary}} to [[paint]] (a [[painting]])

==Russian==

===Alternative forms===

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|title=бежа́ть|:inh|orv:бѣжати<ety:inh<sla-pro:*běžati>>}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|бѣжати}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*běžati}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-bsl-pro|*bēˀgjā́ˀtei}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-pro||*bʰégʷ-y-eh₂-ti}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-||to flee, run}}. 1-st person singular and 3-rd person plural, as well as imperative forms derive from {{m|ru|бечь}}, from {{der|ru|sla-pro|*běťi}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|бежа́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-бежать.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-бежать.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|бежа́ть|both|pf=побежа́ть}}

# {{lb|ru|imperfective|_|only}} to [[run]], to be [[running]]
# to [[flee]], to be [[fleeing]]
# to [[avoid]], to be [[avoiding]], to [[shun]], to be [[shunning]]
# to [[run after]] {{+obj|ru|:за(ins)<someone>}}

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|uni|impf=бежа́ть|pf=побежа́ть|other=бе́гать}}
* Some meanings of the verb are imperfective only (as indicated); others are both imperfective and perfective.

====Conjugation====
''imperfective''
{{ru-conj|impf-intr|irreg|бежа́ть}}
''perfective''
{{ru-conj|pf-intr|irreg|бежа́ть}}
